description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CreditScoring" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Request and present credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Banking" name="Credit-scoring requested through frontend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchDelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" name="Display message to check again later"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeScoringResults" name="Scoring result available"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DisplayScoringResult" name="Display scoring result at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Banking" name="Result displayed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Banking" targetRef="Task_SendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_2" sourceRef="Task_SendScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_MergeScoringResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_6" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_7" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayMessage" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_8" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Gateway_MergeScoringResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_9" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeScoringResults" targetRef="Task_DisplayScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Banking_10" sourceRef="Task_DisplayScoringResult" targetRef="EndEvent_Banking"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Score credit request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 quick scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Outcome" name="Can level 1 determine the result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ImmediateResultSent" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="EndEvent_ImmediateResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" name="Result cannot be determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="EndEvent_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
